description: pinDigests keeps every managed image reference as tag@sha256:..., squid excepted, since that file neither builds nor lints, so a build resolves to the bytes that were reviewed rather than to whatever the tag points at that day. Phobos is a sandbox: the image is the boundary, and a base image that moves under its tag moves the boundary with it. A pinned digest does go stale, which is the point, because Renovate then opens the pull request that moves it and a reviewer sees the change.

helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests does the same for actions. This organisation already refuses an action that is not pinned to a full-length commit SHA, so the preset changes nothing today; it is here so that a tag added by hand is corrected rather than merged.

The two lint container images are named in env values of a run step, and Renovate's github-actions manager reads only uses: docker://, container: and services:, so pinDigests would leave both digests frozen for good. The custom manager below extracts them as docker dependencies. It matches image:tag@sha256:... rather than any string, so it cannot claim an unrelated value, and it is scoped to the workflow directory.

The second custom manager exists for the same reason as the first: Renovate reads no Python dependency out of a shell command, so the versions pinned in the lint workflow's pip install lines and in the python prune image would rot exactly as a lock nobody could regenerate would. It matches name==version only where there is no space around the ==, which is what keeps it off the workflow expressions that compare with == and spaces.
